text: A rack. The ropes are still tied in loops, waiting.
You notice a strange necklace on it.
A skeleton slumps in a chair in the middle of the room, about to slide off it.
A diary is slipping out of its lap.

shackled@3,1.text: A skeleton hanging by its wrists.

shackled@5,1.text: It's wrists are still locked in the shackles.

cage@16,8.text: A cage. There's a lot of different remains of...something...inside the cage.
